verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a general Risk Register, user access reviews, and a GenAI DDQ questionnaire-autofill feature. None of these is a third-party vendor inventory with vendor security-posture assessment, data-access tracking, or vendor review cadence. These are adjacent features (general risk tracking, access reviews of internal systems, answering questionnaires), and adjacent features earn no credit for a vendor risk management story that applies to a compliance platform.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
